_comment: The AtomWorks Studio release this site is built from: the atomworks-studio wheel on PyPI, whose annotation_studio/web/ directory is the browser bundle. tools/build-studio.mjs downloads that wheel, checks it against sha256 (the wheel's, as PyPI lists it) and composes index.html from it. Nothing from Studio is vendored in this repository.
_override: NOT A RELEASE. While `override` is set, assets/ and index.html are built from sokrypton/atomworks-studio branch `design-card-add-sequence` (the Design card's + seq, opened as a PR against RosettaCommons/atomworks-studio), not from the release below: `npm run build:studio` refuses to run, and the site is rebuilt with `npm run build:studio -- --from <packages/web/dist built from override.commit>` (pnpm install && pnpm build; rustup's toolchain). Deployed at the owner's call. Remove `override` and bump `version`, `sha256` once a release contains + seq, then build normally.

override.why: + seq: a chain typed as its sequence, structure free (a peptide or disordered target to bind), on top of Studio 0.0.12.
